== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：雪原</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、メイン・パワー・ジェネレーターが場に出ているなら、フォース消耗に－１。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分の移動フェイズに、ここから山脈にフォースを消費せずに直接移動できる。逆もまた可。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. If you control this site and Main Power Generators is on table, Force drain is -1. Dark Side. During your move phase, you may move from here directly to Mountains without spending Force. The reverse is also allowed.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is 雪原, with 第５マーカー as a separate marker label. Dark names 山脈 and spells out 逆もまた可 where English says “or vice versa”. Two Dark Force icons, no Light Force icons.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-hothiceplains.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)]].</ref>
